links.outcome: Source credibility and citation quality of AI tools' outputs
links.effect: Marked variability in source quality and transparency; some tools cited peer-reviewed literature while others offered minimal sourcing or relied on less credible references.
links.quote: The tools demonstrated marked variability in source quality and transparency, with some consistently providing citations to peer-reviewed literature while others offered minimal sourcing or relied on less credible references.

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of AI-drafted monographs versus reference standards
links.effect: Initial broad prompts yielded vague, incomplete, or inaccurate responses across all tools; section-specific prompts improved quality.
links.quote: Initial broad prompts requesting complete monographs yielded responses that were vague, incomplete, or inaccurate across all tools.

links.outcome: Output quality with refined section-specific prompts versus initial broad prompts
links.effect: Targeted, section-specific prompts substantially improved output quality, with all tools producing more detailed, accurate, and scholarly responses.
links.quote: Refined prompt engineering strategies using targeted, section-specific requests substantially improved output quality, with all AI tools producing more detailed, accurate, and scholarly responses.
